name: space

args.name: count
args.description: Number of spaces to insert.

desc: Returns one or more spaces. One space by default, more if the count argument is specified.

name: newline

args.name: count
args.description: Number of newlines to insert.

desc: Inserts one or more newlines. One newline by default, more if the count argument is specified.

name: noop
desc: Does nothing and produces an empty string.

name: trim

args.name: content
args.description: Content to trim (when used as scoped macro)

desc: Trims whitespace. Non-scoped: trims newlines around the macro (post-processing). Scoped: returns the content (auto-trimmed by the engine).

name: if

args.name: condition
args.description: The condition to evaluate. Prefix with ! to invert. Can be a macro name (auto-resolved), variable shorthand (.var or $var), or a value. Falsy: empty string, "false", "off", "0".

args.name: content
args.description: The content to return if condition is truthy (typically provided as scoped content). May contain {{else}} to define an else branch.

desc: Conditional macro. Returns the content if the condition is truthy, otherwise returns nothing (or the else branch if present). Prefix the condition with ! to invert. If the condition is a registered macro name (without braces), it will be resolved first. Variable shorthands (.varname for local, $varname for global) are also supported.
returns: The content if condition is truthy, else branch or empty string otherwise.

name: else
desc: Marks the else branch inside a scoped {{if}} block. Only works inside {{if}}...{{/if}}. If used outside, returns an invisible marker.
returns: Invisible marker (consumed by the enclosing {{if}} macro).

name: input
desc: Current text from the send textarea.
returns: Current text from the send textarea.

name: maxPrompt
desc: Maximum prompt context size.

name: maxContext
desc: Maximum context token limit.

name: maxResponse
desc: Maximum response token limit.

name: reverse

args.name: value
args.description: The string to reverse.

desc: Reverses the characters of the argument provided.

args.name: comment
args.description:
Any kind of text as comment. If you want multiline comments, consider using a scoped macro like {{//}}First
Second{{///}}.

desc: Comment macro that produces an empty string. Can be used for writing into prompt definitions, without being passed to the context.

name: roll

args.name: formula
args.description: Dice roll formula using droll syntax (e.g. 1d20).

desc: Rolls dice using droll syntax (e.g. {{roll 1d20}}).

name: random
desc: Picks a random item from a list. Will be re-rolled every time macros are resolved.
returns: Randomly selected item from the list.

name: pick
desc: Picks a random item from a list, but keeps the choice stable for a given chat and macro position. Can be rerolled via /reroll-pick slash command.
returns: Stable randomly selected item from the list.

name: banned

args.name: word
args.description: Word to ban for Text Completion backend.

desc: Bans a word for Text Completion backend. (Strips quotes surrounding the banned word, if present)

name: outlet

args.name: key
args.description: Outlet key.

desc: Returns the world info outlet prompt for a given outlet key.

name: user
desc: Your current Persona username.

name: char
desc: The character's name.

name: group
desc: Comma-separated list of group member names (including muted) or the character name in solo chats.

name: groupNotMuted
desc: Comma-separated list of group member names excluding muted members.
returns: List of group member names excluding muted members.

name: notChar
desc: Comma-separated list of all participants except the current speaker.
returns: List of all participants except the current speaker.

name: charPrompt
desc: The character's Main Prompt override.

name: charInstruction
desc: The character's Post-History Instructions override.

name: charDescription
desc: The character's description.

name: charPersonality
desc: The character's personality.

name: charScenario
desc: The character's scenario.

name: persona
desc: Your current Persona description.

name: mesExamplesRaw
desc: Unformatted dialogue examples from the character card.

name: mesExamples
desc: The character's dialogue examples, formatted for instruct mode when enabled.

name: charDepthPrompt
desc: The character's @ Depth Note.

name: charCreatorNotes
desc: Creator notes from the character card.

name: charFirstMessage

args.name: index
args.description: 0-based index. 0 (default) returns the main greeting, 1 and up return alternate greetings.

desc: The character's first message / greeting. Optionally specify an index to access alternate greetings.
returns: Character greeting at the given index, or empty string if out of bounds.

name: charVersion
desc: The character's version number.

name: model
desc: Model name for the currently selected API (Chat Completion or Chat Completion).

name: original
desc: Original message content for {{original}} substitution in in character prompt overrides.

name: isMobile
desc: "true" if currently running in a mobile environment, "false" otherwise.

name: lastGenerationType
desc: Type of the last queued generation request (e.g. "normal", "impersonate", "regenerate", "quiet", "swipe", "continue"). Empty if none yet or chat was switched.
returns: Type of the last queued generation request.

name: hasExtension

args.name: extensionName
args.description: The name of the extension to check

desc: Checks if a specific extension is enabled. If the extension does not exist, returns false.
returns: true if the extension is enabled, false otherwise.

name: lastMessage
desc: Last message in the chat.

name: lastMessageId
desc: Index of the last message in the chat.
returns: Index of the last message in the chat.

name: lastUserMessage
desc: Last user message in the chat.
returns: Last user message in the chat.

name: lastCharMessage
desc: Last character/bot message in the chat.
returns: Last character/bot message in the chat.

name: firstIncludedMessageId
desc: Index of the first message included in the current context.
returns: Index of the first message included in the context.

name: firstDisplayedMessageId
desc: Index of the first displayed message in the chat.
returns: Index of the first displayed message in the chat.

name: lastSwipeId
desc: 1-based index of the last swipe for the last message.

name: currentSwipeId
desc: 1-based index of the current swipe.

name: allChatRange
desc: Range of all message IDs in the chat (e.g. "0-10"). Empty string if the chat is empty.
returns: Range string from 0 to last message ID, or empty string.

name: time

args.name: offset
args.description: UTC offset in the format UTC±(offset).

desc: Current local time, or UTC offset when called as {{time::UTC±(offset)}}
returns: A time string in the format HH:mm.

name: date
desc: Current local date as a string in the local short format.
returns: Current local date in local short format.

name: weekday
desc: Current weekday name.

name: isotime
desc: Current time in HH:mm format.

name: isodate
desc: Current date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: datetimeformat

args.name: format
args.description: Moment.js format string.

desc: Formats the current date/time using the given moment.js format string.

name: idleDuration
desc: Human-readable duration since the last user message.
returns: Human-readable duration since the last user message.

name: timeDiff

args.name: left
args.description: Left time value.

args.name: right
args.description: Right time value.

desc: Human-readable difference between two times. Order of times does not matter, it will return the absolute difference.

name: setvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local variable to set.

args.name: value
args.description: The value to set the local variable to.

desc: Sets a local variable to the given value.

name: addvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local variable to add to.

args.name: value
args.description: The value to add to the local variable.

desc: Adds a value to an existing local variable (numeric or string append). If the variable does not exist, it will be created.

name: incvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local variable to increment.

desc: Increments a local variable by 1 and returns the new value. If the variable does not exist, it will be created.
returns: The new value of the local variable.

name: decvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local variable to decrement.

desc: Decrements a local variable by 1 and returns the new value. If the variable does not exist, it will be created.
returns: The new value of the local variable.

name: getvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local variable to get.

desc: Gets the value of a local variable.
returns: The value of the local variable.

name: hasvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local variable to check.

desc: Checks if a local variable exists.

name: deletevar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local variable to delete.

desc: Deletes a local variable.

name: setvarkey

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local object or array.

args.name: key
args.description: The key of an object or the index of an array.

args.name: value
args.description: The value to set at the specified key or index.

desc: Sets a value at a specific key or index in a local object or array. If the variable does not exist, it will be created based on the type of the key.

name: getvarkey

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the local object or array variable to get from.

args.name: key
args.description: The key of an object or the index of an array.

desc: Gets a value at a specific key or index in a local object or array variable.
returns: The value at the specified key or index in the local object or array variable.

name: setglobalvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global variable to set.

args.name: value
args.description: The value to set the global variable to.

desc: Sets a global variable to the given value.

name: addglobalvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global variable to add to.

args.name: value
args.description: The value to add to the global variable.

desc: Adds a value to an existing global variable (numeric or string append). If the variable does not exist, it will be created.

name: incglobalvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global variable to increment.

desc: Increments a global variable by 1 and returns the new value. If the variable does not exist, it will be created.
returns: The new value of the global variable.

name: decglobalvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global variable to decrement.

desc: Decrements a global variable by 1 and returns the new value. If the variable does not exist, it will be created.
returns: The new value of the global variable.

name: getglobalvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global variable to get.

desc: Gets the value of a global variable.
returns: The value of the global variable.

name: hasglobalvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global variable to check.

desc: Checks if a global variable exists.

name: deleteglobalvar

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global variable to delete.

desc: Deletes a global variable.

name: setglobalvarkey

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global object or array variable.

args.name: key
args.description: The key of an object or the index of an array element to set.

args.name: value
args.description: The value to set at the specified key or index.

desc: Sets a value at a specific key or index in a global object or array variable. If the variable does not exist, it will be created based on the type of the key.

name: getglobalvarkey

args.name: name
args.description: The name of the global object or array variable to get from.

args.name: key
args.description: The key of an object or the index of an array element to get.

desc: Gets a value at a specific key or index in a global object or array variable.
returns: The value at the specified key or index in the global object or array variable.
